metadata.name: ringside
metadata.description: Ringside: onchain duel + in-play win market on MagicBlock ephemeral rollups

instructions.name: claim
docs: Pays a settled position: winning shares 1 USDC each, a draw refunds net cost.
Idempotent; anyone may trigger it and funds only go to the owner's token account.

instructions.name: cleanup_positions
docs: Cleanup crank: commits and undelegates settled positions (remaining accounts) in a batch.

instructions.name: commit_match
docs: Commits the final match state (sim, hash chain head, result) to Solana. Permissionless
after settlement; used by the finalizer right after `finalize`.

instructions.name: create_match
docs: Creates a match, both books, the base-layer MatchRecord and the escrow eATA.

instructions.name: delegate_escrow
docs: Delegates the match escrow eATA (fighter stakes) to the TEE validator.

instructions.name: delegate_match
docs: Delegates the match and both books to the TEE validator (first remaining account).

instructions.name: finalize
docs: Commits the final match and book state to Solana and schedules the MatchRecord receipt
as a post-commit Magic Action. `finalized` counts attempts.

instructions.name: finalize_model
docs: Locks the model, stores the held-out metrics hash and makes it the active version.

instructions.name: init_house_vault
docs: Creates the house vault eATA (owned by the Config PDA) and delegates it to `validator`
(first remaining account).

instructions.name: init_position_permission
docs: Makes a Position private: only its owner (and the house authority) can read it.

instructions.name: join_fight
docs: A fighter joins: stake moves from the player's token account to the match escrow.
The second join starts the match.

instructions.name: join_position
docs: Creates a spectator Position for one book, pre-funded for its ephemeral permission.

instructions.name: relay_delayed_state
docs: TV-delay baseline: the relay posts features that are `delay_ms` old into the Delayed
book. Same pricing code as `tick`, different (late) feed.

instructions.name: request_wave_randomness
docs: Requests the VRF seed for the next power-up wave (one request per wave, never per tick).

instructions.name: reveal_positions
docs: Reveals more positions after settle, in batches of (position, permission) pairs.

instructions.name: schedule_tick
docs: Schedules the match crank on the ER: each iteration runs `tick` then `settle` (a no-op
until the fight ends). The task id is derived from hash(program_id ‖ match_id) and the
scheduled instructions carry no signer accounts.

instructions.name: set_model_params
docs: Chunked write of the 4,744-byte model blob (fits the 1,232-byte transaction limit).

instructions.name: settle
docs: Pays the fighters from escrow, closes both books and reveals any positions passed as
(position, permission) pairs in the remaining accounts. Permissionless and idempotent;
a no-op while the fight is still running (so the crank can call it every tick).

instructions.name: submit_input
docs: A fighter's latest input. Monotonic sequence, at most one per tick.

instructions.name: tick
docs: Advances the duel by one fixed step and re-prices the Ringside book in the same
instruction. Permissionless (crank-scheduled), time-gated and idempotent.

instructions.name: topup_house_vault
docs: Admin moves house liquidity into the house vault on the ER.

instructions.name: trade
docs: Spectator trade against the house. Rejects stale ticks and fighters onchain.
With `record_rejects`, a stale/fighter/frozen rejection is counted onchain and the
transaction succeeds without a fill; otherwise it fails with the error.

instructions.name: vrf_callback
docs: VRF fulfilment: writes the wave seed into the sim state. Bound to the pending request
and idempotent.

instructions.name: withdraw_fees
docs: Admin withdraws a match's accrued fighter fees from the house vault.

instructions.name: write_match_record
docs: Base-layer handler for the finalize Magic Action: writes the MatchRecord receipt.
Only reachable through the post-commit path (escrow signer) scheduled by this program.

errors.name: ErrStaleTick
errors.msg: Fill priced off a stale tick

errors.name: ErrFighterBarred
errors.msg: Fighters and their session keys cannot trade their own match

errors.name: ErrSlippage
errors.msg: Price is worse than the limit

errors.name: ErrExposure
errors.msg: House exposure cap would be exceeded

errors.name: ErrClosed
errors.msg: Market or match is not open

errors.name: ErrNotFighter
errors.msg: Signer is not a fighter in this match

errors.name: ErrBadSeq
errors.msg: Input sequence must increase and inputs are limited to one per tick

errors.name: ErrTooEarly
errors.msg: Too early: time gate not reached

errors.name: ErrBadQueue
errors.msg: Wrong VRF queue or request

errors.name: ErrPaused
errors.msg: Paused

errors.name: ErrMath
errors.msg: Arithmetic error

errors.name: ErrAlreadySettled
errors.msg: Already settled

errors.name: ErrFrozen
errors.msg: Quotes are frozen after a lethal-range hit

errors.name: ErrInsufficientShares
errors.msg: Not enough shares to sell

errors.name: ErrBadQty
errors.msg: Quantity is zero or above the per-trade maximum

errors.name: ErrUnauthorized
errors.msg: Unauthorized

errors.name: ErrInvalidAccount
errors.msg: Invalid account

errors.name: ErrMatchFull
errors.msg: Match is full or the opponent is reserved

errors.name: ErrModel
errors.msg: Model is not finalized or has a bad layout

errors.name: ErrNotSettled
errors.msg: Not settled yet

errors.name: ErrWrongMode
errors.msg: Wrong market mode for this instruction

types.name: Config
docs: Global configuration (base layer, read on the ER).

fields.name: house_vault
docs: House vault token account (ATA of this Config PDA), delegated as an eATA.

fields.name: min_slot_gap
docs: Minimum ER slots between ticks (time gate, with the wall-clock bound in `tick`).

fields.name: freeze_ticks
docs: Quotes stay frozen for this many ticks after a lethal-range hit.

types.name: Market
docs: One order book for one match.

fields.name: p_hist
docs: Mid history, ring buffer of the last 11 priced ticks (micro-USDC).

types.name: Match
docs: One duel. Delegated to the TEE validator; public.

fields.name: last_tick_unix_ms
docs: Wall-clock estimate of the last tick (ER unix seconds × 1000); informational.

fields.name: opponent
docs: Invited opponent (default = open challenge).

types.name: MatchRecord
docs: Settlement receipt on the base layer, written by a Magic Action after the final commit.

types.name: ModelParams
docs: Win-probability model parameters: header + the serialized integer model.

types.name: Position
docs: A spectator's position in one market. Private (PER permission) until reveal.

types.name: RecordArgs
docs: Arguments the finalize action writes into the record.

fields.name: tick
docs: Tick the book was priced on (for the TV-delay book: the relayed, late tick).

fields.name: game_tick
docs: The fight's actual tick when the fill executed.
